# Industrial Boiler & Burner Services (IBBS)

> IBBS is a Lahore-based industrial engineering and supply business serving organizations in Pakistan and international markets, including Saudi Arabia, Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, and Bangladesh. It supplies general industrial parts and process instruments, and provides coal-fired boiler, burner, PLC, and automation services.

## Business

- Legal/business name used on the website: Industrial Boiler & Burner Services (IBBS)
- Based in: Pak Arab Housing Society, Main Ferozepur Road, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Service area: Pakistan and international markets in the Middle East and Asia, including Saudi Arabia, Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, and Bangladesh
- Phone: +92 309 2190828
- Email: info.iibbs@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pakistan time; Sunday closed

## Services and capabilities

- Coal-fired boiler maintenance and overhauling
- Burner systems and support
- PLC-based industrial automation and control panels
- SCADA integration
- Process instrumentation and measurement
- General industrial parts and spare-parts sourcing

Contact IBBS to confirm scope, compatibility, availability, and quotation for a specific requirement. The website does not publish a complete live inventory.
